text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Uwoooaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I won... I wonnnnnnn!!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I am... the Derby Horse Girl!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Winning Ticket has fulfilled
her long-cherished dream of winning the Derby!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
It was such a wonderful run,
it makes anyone want to dream!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOO!!
CHI-KE-ZO!! CHI-KE-ZO!!
CHI-KE-ZO!! CHI-KE-ZO!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Uuuugh...! Everyoneee...!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Thank you sho mush for the shuppooorrrttt...!!
I... I did ittt, I reallly did itttt...!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
*Haa*... *haa*... Dammit.
I lost...!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: (What was that running just now...?! No matter how much I chased, it felt impossible to catch up.)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: (So that's... Ticket's true strength—)

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Thank you soooo muuuuch!!
I'm gonna keep giving it my all from now on too!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"So that everyone can see their dreams come true!!
I'm gonna keep on runningーーー!!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: A dream......

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: (Pure, honest joy. Pure, honest celebration.)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: (—She really is dazzling, that girl.)

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Ticket... It seems I may have
miscalibrated your explosive potential.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: However—this is where giving up victory ends.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I must reconstruct the formula... immediately!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
choice_data_list: Taishin, that was a great run!
Taishin, that was a great run!

text_block_list.text: True, you missed out on the win, but you still made the board. That alone is a remarkable achievement.
Besides—
choice_data_list: The Classics aren't over just yet!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Mm. I know.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I'll never let them call me
someone who lost here and was done for.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: The Kikuka Sho is where... I will win!!
Up next is the final leg of the Triple Crown, the Kikuka Sho.

To seize glory the next time around,
she vowed to build her strength once more—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: —That's right, I have to win.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
As long as I win the race.
I'm sure even I can...
